CHEM 210 AND CHEM 220 are printed as a paired requirement within the selective list.

Choosing 23 units from this list effectively requires CHEM 210, CHEM 220, MATH C2210 and one physics sequence (5+5+5+4+4 = 23); with the 10-unit core this matches the printed Total Required Major Units: 33.

No degree total is printed; the page says to complete Cal-GETC and additional CSU or UC transferable courses as needed to meet the minimum 60 units, so electives_fill_degree is true. No Cal-GETC units are printed.
